plan.high_rate_rule: (previous empirical g + 1.2) / frozen s0 seconds; 1.2 is original 2.2x high-load minus g(1), fixed paired offered rate for previous and new count
plan.g_point_rule: g_new = unchanged g_previous * median of three paired within-window throughput(new)/throughput(previous) ratios at matched rate and seed

sequential_termination.memory: measured safe residency plus minimum admitted background cover exceeds every affected frozen budget; retain measured raw count
sequential_termination.no_repeatable_positive_increment: all three full, capacity-pressured matched pairs have throughput(new)<=throughput(previous); a mixed-sign result is inconclusive and cannot stop the frontier
sequential_termination.low_load_unstable: all three lower-load full windows unstable or repeatable count-specific load/runtime failure; high-load overload alone never excludes a count
sequential_termination.higher_counts_after_true_terminal: terminal-evidenced, not artificial missing; never fill their g/M tables

plan.primary_task_rule: historical measured scaling task if present; otherwise largest summed service demand in frozen 11A capacity witnesses
plan.other_task_probe: 3 serial samples per replica on every other admitted path; separate from capacity window
plan.capacity_scope: Module18 frozen serving validation only; no new capacity profiling or capacity-table updates.

protective_stop.action: Stop arrivals, bounded drain, preserve raw unstable outcome; skip remaining repetitions of that exact condition. No higher budgets, retries or loads.

plan.history_hardware_note: Historical Module7 scaling may originate on a different GPU UUID; keep old points immutable; every new adjacent pair measured on current frozen Module10 hardware.

parameter_source: Same current GPU Module27 development measurements only; no Stage C/D tuning

parameter_derivation.S_lower: pooled P10 of same-worker per-task native handler times
parameter_derivation.G_upper: pooled P95 same-worker per-task native handler times
parameter_derivation.S_inflation: max mixed-session S target mean minus min pure-session S mean
parameter_derivation.background: VQA FIFO blocking lambda*G_service^2/2 plus S overlap inflation envelope
parameter_derivation.margins: one and half conservative S target service time
parameter_derivation.token_limit: half of best tested nonzero fixed10; engineering bound within measured stable envelope
parameter_derivation.fallback: 30s, same as warmup, engineering safety duration; not statistically calibrated

fixed_comparator.reason: Module27 10% beats20% at10.5; only tested nonzero fraction11.5; best measured nonzero prior. S-only0% is stronger prior and included. Not exhaustive optimum.

G_only.reason: Module27 observed G LID mean ~383.52ms implies target alone ~4.41/4.03 handler-s/s, plus VQA. Capacity screen rejects same single-G residency. This is a historical screen, not a measured G-only outcome; no superiority over all legal routes.

profiles.burst: LID inverse integrated-intensity warp: 2s at2x then8s at0.75x in10s cycles. Other5 tasks stationary. Same expected mean; exact offered cohort count unchanged by warp.

failure_policy: ZERO GPU retries/replacements. Stop on unsafe/technical failure, invalid cohort/admission/memory, unclean release, system or worker unstable, or failed thermal pairing. Negative utility alone does not stop the nine registered runs.

safety.campaign_policy: ZERO GPU retries/replacements. Stop on unsafe/technical failure, invalid cohort/admission/memory, unclean release, system or worker unstable, or failed thermal pairing. Negative utility alone does not stop the nine registered runs.

replication_protocol.gate_rule: Invalid/incomplete/unsafe => REPLICATION_INVALID. Any delta<=.01 or missing G/S => DYNAMIC_NOT_REPRODUCED. All six>.01 with either t95 CI crossing zero => DYNAMIC_POSITIVE_INCONCLUSIVE; otherwise DYNAMIC_POSITIVE_REPLICATED. System mean/P95 consistency reported separately; no claim of uniform latency improvement without evidence.
